base.description: Base directory where nmzmail builds its index. Defaults to $HOME/.nmzmail.

result.description: Directory where nmzmail builds search results. Defaults to within base directory.

limit.description: Limit on the number of results returned from a query. Set to 0 or null for no limit.

maildirs.description: List of maildir paths to index. Example: ["/home/user/Mail/inbox", "/home/user/Mail/archive"].
